title: [Feature Request] klipper: Add the ability to change the order of added actions and commands.
line: In the Clipboard settings, actions and their commands can now be reordered by dragging them.
explanation: The actions list on the Clipboard settings' Actions Configuration page had drag and drop turned off, so the only way to change the order of actions (which is also the order of the action menu) or of the commands inside an action was to delete them and add them again. The change turns on internal drag and drop in that tree: actions can be dropped between other actions and commands only between the commands of their own action, and every move is mirrored in the action list that gets saved, enabling Apply.

commits.message:
klipper: allow reordering actions and commands by drag and drop

The only way to change the order of actions, or of the commands in an
action, was to delete and add them again. Actions can now be dragged
among actions, and commands within their own action, in the settings.

BUG: 477382

media.caption: Master: dragging the "Image file" action up, then the Chromium command above Firefox, only moves the selection; nothing is reordered.
With the fix: "Image file" is dragged to the top and the Chromium command above Firefox; Apply lights up.
Master after both drags: order unchanged.
With the fix: after dragging the action (left) and the command (right).
